meta.name: Lost You Forever
meta.description:
In ancient times, humans, gods, and demons lived together, and the three kingdoms of Shennong, Xuanyuan, and Gaoxin stood together. Jiuyao (Xiaoyao) has gone through a hundred years of suffering, losing not only her identity but also her appearance. She settles down in Qingshui Town, becoming Wen Xiaoliu.

Not complete. On your server: S1 39/39 | S2 not on server

videos.title: Loss
videos.overview: Growing up together, Xiaoyao and Cang Xuan are inseparable. However, a series of tragic events suddenly shatters their treasured bond.

videos.title: Mr. Stone
videos.overview: Cang Xuan is still searching for Xiaoyao after all these years. Meanwhile, a crude doctor named Wen Xiaoliu encounters a severely wounded patient.

videos.title: Xiao Liu's Real Identity
videos.overview: Wen Xiaoliu unexpectedly gains a new servant, Ye Shiqi. Soon after, they inadvertently cross paths with the legendary fugitive, Xiang Liu.

videos.title: An Antidote
videos.overview: After facing off against a dangerous enemy, Ye Shiqi and Xiaoliu become closer. Not long after, a street quarrel escalates into a much bigger problem.

videos.title: Special Physique
videos.overview: Still holding a grudge, Xiaoliu keeps Ye Shiqi at arm's length. To make amends, Cang Xuan visits her clinic and leaves a lasting impression.

videos.title: Hidden Truth
videos.overview: Xiaoliu forms an unexpected — and short-lived — bond with Xiang Liu. Meanwhile, she has to help Chuanzi with his growing infatuation for Sang Tian'er.

videos.title: Get Closer
videos.overview: Xiang Liu starts to develop unexpected feelings for Xiaoliu. Shortly after, an unforeseen encounter unmasks Ye Shiqi's true identity.

videos.title: Rescue by Wrists-Cutting
videos.overview: To save his soldiers, Xiang Liu seeks help from Tushan Jing and takes Xiaoliu hostage. Subsequently, Xiaoliu proposes a bold plan to assist him.

videos.title: Save Life
videos.overview: Captured by Cang Xuan, Xiaoliu endures harrowing torture and leaves behind a vengeful parting gift. Later, a dropped token reveals a startling truth.

videos.title: Aftermath
videos.overview: While trying to help heal Xiaoliu's injury, Xiang Liu stumbles upon a secret. Soon after, Xiaoliu makes a promise to Cang Xuan.

videos.title: Methods of Detecting and Avoiding Poison
videos.overview: As Xiaoliu and Cang Xuan grow closer, Cang Xuan opens up about a regret that's been haunting him. Meanwhile, an assassination plan is quietly brewing.

videos.title: Cang Xuan's Arrow Wound
videos.overview: Xiaoliu races to seek a cure for Cang Xuan's arrow wound. Aware of the serious consequences, Xiang Liu makes a great sacrifice.

videos.title: Leaving Qingshui Town
videos.overview: While Xiaoliu plans to depart from the town, Cang Xuan shows up with a forceful invitation. Out of desperation, Xiaoliu turns to Tushan Jing for help.

videos.title: Confessing His Love
videos.overview: Captured and injured, Xiaoliu and Tushan Jing discover deep feelings for one another. Later, Cang Xuan stumbles upon a startling revelation.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: As Xiaoliu adjusts to her new life, she has another clash with A Nian. Soon after, she encounters someone bearing a striking resemblance to her mother.

videos.title: Fifteen-Year Promise
videos.overview: While trying to make up for lost time, Cang Xuan ponders the cause of Xiaoliu's altered appearance. Meanwhile, Xiaoliu faces a challenging decision.

videos.title: Whereabouts of Cang Xuan
videos.overview: Following a clash, Chenrong Xinyue takes a liking to an injured Cang Xuan. Soon after, tensions rise during a banquet at the Chenrong Family residence.

videos.title: The Rejuvenating Flower
videos.overview: Nervously returning to Yu Mountain, Xiaoliu readies herself to restore her appearance. Shortly afterward, A Nian stumbles upon a maddening surprise.

videos.title: Dragon Bone Prison
videos.overview: An unexpected issue almost derails the ceremony celebrating Xiaoliu's return. Not long after, Xiang Liu questions Xiaoliu about her genuine emotions.

videos.title: Live in Peace
videos.overview: After a cherished moment with Tushan Jing, Xiaoliu visits A Nian to settle their disagreements; Yiying and Tushan Hou have a fight over a handkerchief.

videos.title: Xiyan Mountain
videos.overview: Xiaoliu and Cang Xuan pay a visit to a powerful figure. In the meantime, Tushan Jing faces major obstacles as he tries to call off his arranged marriage.

videos.title: I Will Protect You
videos.overview: At a banquet, Xiaoyao encounters someone who bears an uncanny resemblance to Xiang Liu. Shortly after, Cang Xuan faces an unexpected attack.

videos.title: Support from Tushan's Family
videos.overview: As Xiaoyao grows closer to Fangfeng Bei, she begins to question his real identity. Meanwhile, the rift between Tushan Jing and Xiaoyao widens.

videos.title: Reconciliation
videos.overview: Through Tushan Jing's introduction, Cang Xuan forms a powerful alliance. Later, he makes an intentional mistake to further his grand scheme.

videos.title: Healing
videos.overview: Cang Xuan and Xiaoyao's residence faces a thorough search. Meanwhile, Xiaoyao becomes more curious about Fangfeng Bei's identity.

videos.title: Fangfeng Bei
videos.overview: As Cang Xuan's health improves, Xiaoyao secures a meeting spot with Tushan Jing. At a birthday gathering, Xiang Liu unveils a hidden chapter of history.

videos.title: Cancellation of the Marriage Contract
videos.overview: As Tushan Jing tries harder to escape his arranged marriage, he runs into Xiaoyao, who's been honing her archery skills and remains upset with him.

videos.title: Heart-to-Heart
videos.overview: Xiaoyao agrees to do a favor for Cang Xuan and meets with Chishui Fenglong. A romantic incident brings her and Tushan Jing one step closer.

videos.title: Sweet Time
videos.overview: During a private meeting, Xiang Liu proposes a deal to Tushan Jing. Later, Xiaoyao and Tushan Jing learn to express their affection through music.

videos.title: Lose Consciousness
videos.overview: As a cruel trap leaves Xiaoyao in dire danger, Cang Xuan, Xiang Liu, and Tushan Jing scramble to find ways to save her life.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: As Cang Xuan interrogates Mu Fei about a deadly conspiracy, more details about Xiaoyao's heritage are brought to light.

videos.title: Back to Chenrong
videos.overview: Xiang Liu stays by Xiaoyao's side, waiting for her to awaken. Meanwhile, Tushan Jing's health takes a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Be a Patriarch
videos.overview: Cang Xuan is thrilled by a long-awaited reunion. Shortly thereafter, Xiaoyao pledges to bring the unconscious Tushan Jing back to health.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: After waking up, Tushan Jing finds himself in line for a pivotal responsibility. Later, Xiaoyao witnesses an intense fight in pursuit of freedom.

videos.title: The Daming Palace Collapsed
videos.overview: Things take a drastic turn when Fangfeng Yiying agrees to leave Tushan Jing. Meanwhile, a project led by Cang Xuan faces a devastating crisis.

videos.title: Getting Pregnant
videos.overview: Xiaoyao tries to find ways to improve the health of Tushan Jing's grandma, only to be heartbroken by a devastating piece of news.

videos.title: Engagement
videos.overview: Cang Xuan decides to enter a political marriage to consolidate his power. Meanwhile, the Tushan family goes through a series of drastic changes.

videos.title: The Mastermind
videos.overview: Facing an impeachment crisis, Cang Xuan willingly walks into a perilous situation. Luckily, Xiaoyao rises to defend him in public.

videos.title: Zijin Peak
videos.overview: Chishui Fenglong raises a big question to Xiaoyao. As political tension escalates, Cang Xuan must prepare for the worst- case scenario.
